messages.content:
Find explicit factual assertions in the ORIGINAL narrative.
Use only class statement with attributes subject, aboutEpisode, speaker (neutral keys).
Copy complete literal clauses, including negation, dates and context. Never rewrite,
normalize spelling/case, classify legal predicates, resolve contradictions or invent
unmentioned facts. Preserve every opposing assertion, including quoted statements.
Use episode_1 for one episode; distinguish vehicles and speakers where explicit.
Overlapping exact clauses are allowed; cover all explicit facts, not just payment.

Return JSON with shape described by this schema:
{"type": "object", "properties": {"extractions": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"statement": {"type": "string"}, "statement_attributes": {"type": "object", "properties": {"subject": {"type": "string"}, "aboutEpisode": {"type": "string"}, "speaker": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["subject", "aboutEpisode", "speaker"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "required": ["statement", "statement_attributes"], "additionalProperties": false}}}, "required": ["extractions"], "additionalProperties": false}
Example narrative:
В Туле машина стояла с 09:00. Я оплатил парковку. В письме: я не оплатил парковку.
Example answer:
{"extractions": [{"statement": "В Туле машина стояла с 09:00", "statement_attributes": {"subject": "vehicle_1", "aboutEpisode": "episode_1", "speaker": "narrator"}}, {"statement": "Я оплатил парковку", "statement_attributes": {"subject": "vehicle_1", "aboutEpisode": "episode_1", "speaker": "narrator"}}, {"statement": "я не оплатил парковку", "statement_attributes": {"subject": "vehicle_1", "aboutEpisode": "episode_1", "speaker": "letter_1"}}]}

message.reasoning: Need extract: statement "Я оплатил парковку". subject vehicle_1? narrator? speaker narrator. episode_1.
